setPassword.title: Set your password
setPassword.subtitle: Choose a password to activate your account.
setPassword.invalidDescription: This invite link is missing its token. Check the link in your email, or ask an admin to resend the invite.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset it.
forgotPassword.successDescription: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Enter a new password for your account.
resetPassword.invalidDescription: This reset link is missing its token, invalid, or has expired. Request a new one.

mfaChallenge.title: Enter your verification code
mfaChallenge.subtitle: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code, or use a recovery code.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.disabledDescription: Add an extra layer of security to your account.
twoFactor.scanQr: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
twoFactor.recoveryCodesHint: Each code can be used once if you lose access to your authenticator app. Store them somewhere safe — they will not be shown again.
twoFactor.disableConfirmDescription: Enter your current password to confirm.
